title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's rollover protection structure (ROPS) can fail to protect consumers, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Children's Hooded Jackets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The zipper slider can detach from the hoodie, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 25,000.

title: Skip Hop Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Injury and Fall Hazards
summary: The legs on the highchair can detach from the seat, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 32,300 (In addition, about 8,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Foremost Recalls Shower Doors and Panels Due to Injury and Impact Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The pivot hinges can fail and cause the glass door panel to separate from its frame, posing impact and injury hazards. Units: About 700.

title: Signature Hardware Recalls Wall-Mounted Shower Seats Due to Fall and Laceration Hazards
summary: The aluminum hardware supporting the shower seat can corrode, posing fall and laceration hazards. Units: About 7,200 (in addition, about 80 were sold in Canada).

title: Miles Industries Recalls Gas Fireplaces Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The trim around the fireplaces can leak hot exhaust air, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 1,000 (in addition, about 1,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Navien Recalls Tankless Water Heaters and Boilers Due to Risk of Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: A kit installed on the tankless water heaters and boilers to convert them from natural gas to propane can cause the unit to produce excessive amounts of carbon monoxide, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to consumers. Units: About 3,400.

title: Manhattan Toy Recalls Children's Books Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A metal grommet used to attach a fabric flap to a page in the book can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,180 (in addition, about 20 were sold in Canada).

title: Women's Iron Complete Supplements Recalled by GNC Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The dietary supplement blister packaging is not child resistant, as required by federal law. If ingested by a child, these supplements could cause serious injury or death. Units: About 756,000.

title: TerraTrike Recalls Adult Tricycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The torque sensor in the wheel can activate unexpectedly and cause the trike to power forward, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 450.

title: The Children's Place Recalls Infant Snowsuits Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snaps on the snowsuit can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 14,900 (in addition, about 750 were sold in Canada).

title: Lotus Foods Recalls Ramen Noodle Soup Cups Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The paper soup cup's labeling incorrectly instructs consumers to use the microwave for cooking, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 239,000.

title: The Company Store Recalls Children's Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 13,000.

title: TJX Recalls Drawer Knobs Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls, and HomeGoods Stores
summary: The glass and ceramic drawer knobs can break or shatter when pulled, posing a laceration hazard Units: About 21,500 (in addition, about 1,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Women's Scarves Recalled by Raj Imports Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 300.

title: dormakaba USA Recalls Stanley Commercial Hardware Locksets Due to Risk of Entrapment in an Emergency
summary: The lockset can fail to open, posing an entrapment hazard and inability to vacate a location in an emergency. Units: About 13,500 (in addition, about 800 were sold in Canada and about 200 were sold in Mexico).

title: White-Rodgers Recalls Thermostats Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Contact between the thermostat wires and household line voltage can damage the thermostat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 135,000 (in addition, about 15,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Kubota Recalls Zero Turn Mowers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The rollover protective structure (ROPS) on the mower can loosen and fail to protect the operator in a rollover accident, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 11,670.

title: Penn State Industries Recalls Woodworking Jaw Chuck Systems Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The jaws can loosen from the chuck and break off, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,000.
